query:
SELECT count() AS first_observed_learners,
countIf(first_start + INTERVAL 24 HOUR > now()) AS pending_24h,
countIf(first_start + INTERVAL 24 HOUR <= now()) AS mature_starts,
countIf(first_start + INTERVAL 24 HOUR <= now() AND first_completion >= first_start AND first_completion <= first_start + INTERVAL 24 HOUR) AS mature_completed
FROM (
 SELECT distinct_id, min(started_at) AS first_start, argMin(completed_at,started_at) AS first_completion
 FROM (
  SELECT distinct_id, properties.lesson_id AS lesson_id, properties.attempt_id AS attempt_id,
  countIf(event='lesson_started') AS has_start,
  minIf(timestamp,event='lesson_started') AS started_at,
  minIf(timestamp,event='lesson_completed') AS completed_at
  FROM events
  WHERE timestamp >= toDateTime('2026-10-15 15:00:00','UTC') AND timestamp < now()
  AND properties.client='seodang-capacitor' AND properties.environment='production'
  AND event IN ('lesson_started','lesson_completed') AND properties.attempt_id IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY distinct_id,lesson_id,attempt_id
 ) WHERE has_start > 0 GROUP BY distinct_id
) WHERE first_start >= toDateTime('2026-10-17 15:00:00','UTC') AND first_start < toDateTime('2026-10-18 15:00:00','UTC')
